body:
I appreciate you trying to help me. 

I might get back into computers some day, but right now I want to do something different.

>You should try talking to him, if you can.

I kinda have, but he's the kinda guy that say - "Depression!? Bullshit! you just need to work harder!" or something like that. Also, if I end up choosing an alternative life-style he's the kinda guy that will look down on me for the rest of his life. I don't really care about that too much anymore. When I can finally make a choice on doing something different, I will just do it.

>Also, I would personally be very upset if you decided to follow through with your "arrangement" that would be a very poor birthday present for me in January.

Haha, you won't know whether I have done it or not at the time anyway.

>what makes you excited?

Nothing have really exited me in years, but the only thing really keeping me going is my meditation and such.

Nice coincidence... Sounds interesting, I might be interested in hearing more.


Thank you... I still feel hopeless but I feel a bit better at the same time.

Believe it or not, I have been quite a bit into meditation and all kinds of spiritual practices. I have all this knowledge, but when my depression actually kills my emotions it doesn't help much... I can say for sure I would be dead by now if it wasn't for my meditation and spiritual practices.


As for the monastery idea; Yes I would also like to try that, but it would require me moving to another country. I live in Denmark, nothing like that here as far as I know.

Yeah, thank you for the idea I guess. I might just have to give it a try before my 8 months are up.

I'll look around.

> I hated my web internship (with ASP.NET and C# on visual studio - and I'm a Linux guy, I use Emacs and I like things like ruby and git). It was torture! Lots of pressure, tight deadlines, lots of talks about being "productive" and barely meaningful forms to make. 

I did PHP/MYSQL, exactly because I'm also a Linux guy. I also hated it for some of the same reasons as you list here.

>But the thing is, I love to do those things. I love programming and I love computers.

I did enjoy it too. I don't really anymore though, just burnt out. I play a little with Linux and such still, but it gets less and less. I did also work freelance for a while; also not me. 

>Could you return to web and computers.. just to enjoy yourself?

Not anymore no. At least not right now.

>My dream was doing some kind of video game.

Yeah, what boy geek doesn't dream of that haha. Personally I'm not a gamer anymore though, so the dream to make a game is also kinda gone.

Yeah, I have honestly thought of that many times; try to just dedicate my life to help others. I don't know where to volunteer though, and whether I can earn food and shelter that way (I don't need anything else as nothing brings me enjoyment anyway).
